item.title: August 15, 2026 - Over time, not overnight
item.description: Page 237. "We found that we do not recover physically, mentally, or spiritually overnight." Just for Today: My body will heal a little, my mind will become a little clearer, and my relationship with my Higher Power will strengthen.
